commit: feat(asset): inline svg in dev if within limit

truth.description: fileToDevUrl now reads every SVG id from disk at cleanUrl(id) to decide on inlining, but assetImportMetaUrl passes fileToUrl the public URL path it builds from publicDir, such as /logo.svg, so the read throws, the error is swallowed, and new URL('/logo.svg', import.meta.url) is left unrewritten with a false warning and without the base, which breaks the image in dev when base is /app/.

distractions.why: A data URL carries the whole file, so an edited inlined asset already yields a new URL, and a ?t= query appended to it would corrupt the data.
